evidence: Decoupling caps hug U1's pin rows on all sides (C1/C2 left, C3 bottom, C4 right) within ~2-3mm with no other component interposed between any cap and the IC pins.

The chain reads left-to-right without doubling back: SPI header J2 (input) at left, controller U1 with crystal Y1 in the center, RJ45 magnetics J1 (output) at the right edge, power J3 entering from the top.

The straight attach lines between U1's right pin row and J1 visibly intersect near C4/Y1 (lines to J1's lower power pads 9/10 cross the TX/RX lines rising to pads 1-4), and the six J2-to-U1 lines converge with apparent crossings at U1's upper-left pads, forcing avoidable crossover traces.
There is no on-board regulation stage; the +3V3/GND input header J3 feeds U1 directly with bulk/decoupling capacitance placed at the IC, so input-to-load placement order is satisfied.
